about_the_game:
Suit up, cat pilot. Earth needs you.

In Astro Burn, you play as Astro — a fearless feline space pilot returning from a deep-space mission, only to find Earth in ruins, encircled by towering A.I. war machines… and not a single human in sight.

Armed with blazing firepower and purrfect reflexes, blast your way through waves of deadly enemies, uncover the truth behind humanity’s disappearance, and take the fight to the mechanical overlords.

This is arcade-style mayhem with a modern twist — a nostalgic side-scrolling shoot-’em-up inspired by 16-bit classics, reborn with slick modern pixel art, tight controls, and adrenaline-pumping action.

Bullet Hell Time!

Astro Burn is your ticket back to the golden era of 90s side-scrolling shoot-’em-ups — where the screen is flooded with enemy fire, and only your reflexes stand between glory and a game over.

Unleash pixel-powered chaos as you dodge, weave, and fire through waves of relentless enemies in classic bullet hell fashion. It’s fast. It’s furious. And it never lets up.

Mystery Story 

Between the chaos and carnage, take a breather and uncover a gripping mystery—why is Earth surrounded by colossal machines, and where have all the humans gone?

Bombastic weapons to rage against the machines!

Astro Burn arms you to the teeth with an outrageous arsenal—from pulse lasers and grenade blasts to multi-fire scatter shots and beyond! Stack your weapons, unleash them all at once, and rain down pixel-powered chaos as you take on waves of cunning, deadly machines that won’t go down easy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better (integrated or dedicated GPU)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Stereo sound
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Stereo sound

short_description: A retro-inspired, side-scrolling bullet hell shoot-’em-up, where you play as a feline space pilot blasting through waves of strange machines to uncover Earth’s mysterious downfall.
